authority: Continue #421 on the existing branch; owner permits author self-review, not independent scientific confirmation. Preserve original acceptance, all closed results, protected cohorts and frozen validation model.
questions: Which complete native Smolder transitions are shared with the archived ToxicMist/Mistbound/Catalyst system, and which registered producer/mediator/consumer obligations differ?
What source-attributed opportunities can be certified or excluded from already retained native Ash V5/V0 command traces without inventing omitted state or running another game?
method: Check exact source bodies and full native action envelopes, preserve target multiplicity, damage/death guards, status events, costs, Exhaust and lifecycle. Produce explicit source relations, not novelty from shared names or consumer differences. Reuse the complete assigned Ash 128-policy by four-seed rectangles; inspect every command and retain per-row classification. No sampled successful examples and no replacement seeds.

attribution.clean_direct_source_witness: A legal VenomStrike adds poison to its surviving selected target when that target has zero poison, followed by a legal positive-poison Catalyst on the same target before any intervening endTurn, death/transfer or other poison addition. Non-poison commands may intervene. The observed amplification must match the exact native multiplier. This certifies a limited factual source-to-stock chain, not an HP counterfactual, policy viability or package admission.
attribution.conservative_upper_bound: Carry possible VenomStrike provenance per target after a witnessed addition; propagate conservatively to all living targets on an observed death or shatter because native jump may transfer stock. Clear only at a verified zero stock or a fresh combat. Count a legal Catalyst on positive possibly sourced stock as possible; never infer causality from this upper bound.
attribution.unknown: Missing observables, ambiguous source, tick saturation, intervention-dependent future actions and policy counterfactuals remain unknown. Absence of a clean direct witness is not certified inactivity.
attribution.cohort: Exactly the retained native capacity policy root 73209000, indices 0-127, seeds 73209100-73209103 for Ash vows 5 and 0. Retrospective reuse, zero new or independent samples.

decision.source: A distinguishing trace disproves only the named complete-package alias. A guarded source expansion proves only its declared common-background relation. Neither is a complete closed-family quotient unless all required comparisons and composition rules are actually established.
decision.capacity: A sound source-attributed upper bound below the original capacity minimum is a scoped exclusion of this fixed witness supplier. A surviving upper bound or direct witness does not admit the package or revise the old capacity terminal.
decision.integrity: Any source, hash, coverage or event-binding mismatch fails closed and preserves diagnostics; fix delivery defects without changing observations or verdict rules.
